Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the background been changed to depict a basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background has been replaced with a basketball-court setting, supported by recognizable court cues such as a hoop, basketball, or court floor markings; the entire court need not be visible. partial: the background shows some basketball or court-related cues, but they do not establish a basketball-court setting, or the background change is only partial. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background to a basketball court. unknown: the image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the background depicts a basketball court.
node.binding: The image background; assess whether it depicts the requested basketball-court setting using visible court cues, without requiring the whole court to fit in frame.
